text:
lina: Noticed a weird spike in PRs where SAST reports come back as "scan: failed to decrypt evidence" and the PRs auto-assign "owner: unknown". This started after yesterday's access tidy. Anyone tracking KMS/keystore changes?

omar: saw a few failures too. Build log shows: PermissionDenied on KMS.decrypt for serviceAccount:pr-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Might be related to the group-to-serviceaccount mapping change.

scan-bot: job:pr-scan-3821 -> ERROR PermissionDenied: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/pr-evidence: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:pr-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

kevin: I merged an infra tidy PR that removed the nested group infra-scanners-old (PR#5120). I didn't touch KMS bindings but that group was listed in a key binding. Sorry, could be my change.

lina: Can someone check audit logs for the membership removal? We need who/when/what for the postmortem and to decide whether findings were missed.

audit-bot: Audit search: IAM policy change at ts=3654321075 by infra-automation@redwood-inference removed member infra-scanners-old from binding projects/rdw-prod/.../cryptoKeys/pr-evidence policy. Log id: projects/rdw-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/entries/pmq789. Retention=30d.

sec-oncall: Opening incident channel #inc-365432-pr-scan-decrypt. Short-term mitigations: 1) grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to pr-scanner SA, 2) re-run blocked PR scans and queue a backfill for the last 24h, 3) tag any findings surfaced during gap as "suspect-gap" until owner re-validates.

omar: mitigation applied and queued re-runs. Also proposing a presubmit check: when infra PRs change groups used in KMS bindings, run a simulated decrypt from each scanner SA as part of the CI presubmit. I can draft a small harness.

kevin: I'll add the explicit scanner SAs to the keystore binding as well (avoid relying on nested groups). We should also add an alert for any IAM delta that removes a member that resolves to a known scanner SA.

lina: Agreed on explicit bindings + presubmit. Also request: extend keystore audit retention to 90d for faster forensic work and add an RBAC-change Slack alert.

sec-oncall: Action items created: A) short RFC for runbook and presubmit (lina), B) inventory scanner SAs and add explicit keystore members (kevin), C) presubmit decrypt harness PR (omar), D) extend audit retention & alert (infra/security). Marking triage done.

scan-bot: queued: pr-scan backfill job #3822 started (re-decrypting archived evidence).

lina: I'll post an incident summary and link the RFC once created. Owners: please re-check any open PRs with SAST findings in the last 24h.

sec-oncall: Closing triage note: label findings with timestamp window 3654321000-3654321075 as "suspect-gap" and require owner confirmation before closing. :white_check_mark:
